description: Conjure fantasy spell names tagged with their school of magic — evocation, illusion, necromancy, and more.

faqs.a: Evocation, Illusion, Necromancy, Abjuration, Divination, Enchantment, Conjuration, and Transmutation.
faqs.q: Which schools of magic are included?

faqs.a: Every spell shows its school, so you can sort your spellbook properly.
8 spells per click, all unique in the batch.
Click any spell to copy its name and school.

howto: Click any spell to copy it.
title: Spell Name Generator
